summary.text: Doyle Boudreaux is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 39, representing Lafayette, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2026 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Doyle Boudreaux's occupation as Retired, Lafayette Fire Department - Hazardous Materials Unit; Business Owner.
It lists Doyle Boudreaux's education as Carencro High School, 1989; The Wharton School of Business, University of Pennsylvania, Executive Management, 2026; Mensa Member.
The House member page lists Doyle Boudreaux's committee assignments as Administration of Criminal Justice; Retirement; Transportation, Highways and Public Works.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
